findings.description: The policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*"), violating least privilege and allowing the IAM user to perform virtually any action across these services.

Creating an IAM access key for a user establishes long-lived static credentials tied to an overly permissive user, increasing risk of credential leakage and misuse instead of using temporary roles/credentials.

findings.issue_category: use of IAM user instead of role
findings.description: Defining a standalone IAM user with attached broad permissions and generated access keys increases attack surface compared to using roles with temporary credentials, and force_destroy=true can allow silent removal of access keys/data.
The output block exposes aws_iam_access_key.user.encrypted_secret, which surfaces sensitive credential material in Terraform outputs/state and CLI output, risking credential leakage.
